task.task_name: Implement CLI profile configuration and mutually pinned contact cards
task.description: Implement the new apps/cli runtime configuration and profile APIs required by the reviewed CLI prototype and the existing RED tests.
acceptance_criteria: A profile initializes once with stable public identities and encrypted persistent state.
Wrong store keys fail without replacing the database.
Configuration is strict and allows plaintext HTTP only on loopback hosts.
Contact cards carry complete signed Signal bundle v2 and no private material.
Both peers explicitly confirm and durably pin all four identifiers before messaging.
Forged or changed identities fail without trust mutation, and normal diagnostics redact secrets/plaintext.
All nine provided RED tests pass without weakening their assertions.
task.context: Use existing createIdentityProfile/createSignedDeviceRecord and session-node EncryptedSqliteStore, SignalClient, exportSignedSignalBundleV2/importVerifiedSignalBundleV2. Store private identity metadata and contacts inside the encrypted transactional store. The database key comes only from the configured environment variable. The repository is on unborn main; do not commit.
task.module_patterns: ESM TypeScript, strict compiler settings inherited from tsconfig.base.json, Vitest colocated tests, named exports, workspace dependencies.

test_case_specs.run_command: pnpm exec vitest run apps/cli/src/runtime/config.test.ts apps/cli/src/runtime/profile.test.ts
